title: [clinic · EX-18] Solve abstention
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-18` — Solve abstention](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-18-solve-abstention.md) · difficulty ⚫

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Trying yet another score threshold. The repo has measured four and they sit near chance — see finding 3 in the README.

**2.** Evaluating on a class-balanced subsample, which flatters precision ([#7](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/7)).

**3.** Optimising F1 without saying what the asymmetry is. A confident wrong answer and a refusal are not equally bad, and the ratio decides the operating point.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-18]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
